📜 Return & Refund Policy

Official Digital Goods Terms for the LycheeMC Minecraft Network

⚡ 1. In-Game Digital Delivery Guarantee

All virtual ranks, crate keys, and shards bundles are digital gaming goods fulfilled directly via automatic server commands to your Minecraft username on play.lycheemc.fun. Deliveries are generally fulfilled within seconds. If in-game delivery does not arrive within 15 minutes, our team will manually re-deliver your items via Discord.

📦 2. Non-Refundable Digital Goods Notice

In accordance with international consumer laws for intangible digital entertainment content and Minecraft Commercial EULA standards, all purchases of virtual ranks, keys, and currency are final and non-refundable once delivered to an account. These items cannot be returned, exchanged, or revoked for cash once activated in-game.

🔁 3. Duplicate or Accidental Transactions

If you were charged multiple times for the exact same order due to a payment gateway timeout or accidental double click, please contact our administrative team via Discord within 48 hours with your 12-digit UPI UTR reference number or bank transaction screenshot. Verified duplicate charges will be refunded or credited as store balance upon ledger confirmation.

⛔ 4. Chargeback & Dispute Policy

Initiating an unauthorized chargeback, dispute, or payment reversal without contacting store administration first constitutes fraud and will result in an immediate and permanent blacklist/ban across all LycheeMC game modes, web services, and our Discord network.

🎫 5. Player Billing Assistance

Need help with an existing order or have a question before buying? Our billing staff is available 24/7 on Discord. Open a ticket in #billing-support at our official server.
